item.title: Coupling Fast Zn 2+ Kinetics With V–O Framework Stabilization via Nitrogen‐Rich Interfacial Engineering of Spinel ZnV 2 O 4
item.description:
با مهندسی بین‌سطحی غنی از نیتروژن با GCN در کاتد اسپینل ZnV2O4، سینتیک Zn2+ و پایداری چارچوب V-O در باتری آبی روی-یون بهبود یافت.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using graphitic carbon nitride as a nitrogen-rich interfacial regulator to physically integrate with spinel ZnV₂O₄, enabling polar N sites that boost Zn²⁺ kinetics and stabilize the V–O framework. Significance: this interfacial engineering strategy delivers high-rate, durable vanadate cathodes (405 mAh g⁻¹, 3000-cycle stability), advancing practical aqueous zinc-ion batteries.
🏷 aqueous zinc-ion battery · ZnV2O4 cathode · g-C3N4 interface · Zn2+ kinetics · V-O stabilization
